description:
About the job

Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The e-commerce industry has grown tremendously recently, becoming a hotly contested space among leading Internet companies. Its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our campaign team. Together, we can build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.

Step into a dynamic role with the Mexico operation team, where you'll play a vital part in executing varies campaigns for some of the most iconic brands. Be at the forefront of innovation, contributing to cutting-edge campaigns and driving forward the yearly strategic modules that define success. In this role, you’ll help power the future of e-commerce, supporting high-impact initiatives that connect brands with consumers in meaningful ways. Join us as we shape the future of e-commerce here at TikTok Shop!

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 3 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:


 Assist in empowering and incubating high-potential e-commerce creators by providing daily support, guidance, and encouragement on content production techniques.
 Actively communicate and build strong, trust-based relationships with creators and agency hosts, ensuring they feel supported and motivated to achieve their sales goals.
 Support the team in matching curated product assortments with the right creators, helping to brainstorm and co-create engaging e-commerce content (short videos & livestreams).
 Help organize and facilitate training sessions for livestream hosts, assisting them in understanding livestreaming tools, refining on-camera scripts, and improving viewer interaction.
 Assist in tracking and analyzing post-livestream data. Help translate these data insights into easy-to-understand, actionable advice that creators can use to optimize their future sessions.
 Guide creators to maintain high-quality content standards and adhere to platform guidelines, fostering a healthy e-commerce ecosystem.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related fields
 Strong skills in interpersonal and communication; you are a "people person" who genuinely enjoys interacting, listening, and building rapport with diverse individuals.
 Proactive fast-learner, open to navigating uncertain and exploratory business scenarios.
 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume.
 Proven skills in analytical with a willingness to learn how to use data to formulate actionable strategies.


Preferred Qualifications


 Strong analytical skills, with a structured and critical approach to problem-solving;
 Experience in TikTok platform, short-form video trends, and the livestreaming e-commerce ecosystem.


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a BC (Business Campaign) Campaign Strategy Intern at DiDi, you will support the design, execution, and performance analysis of marketing and activation campaigns that drive restaurants and consumers acquisition, retention, and platform engagement across multiple regions. Your work will directly contribute to measurable increases in user activation rates, cost-per-acquisition improvement, and campaign ROI while helping the campaign strategy team scale targeted programs across DiDi’s large, multi-product ecosystem.

In this role, you'll be...


Analyze campaign performance data and generate weekly dashboards and insights that identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities, contributing to a 10–20% improvement in campaign KPIs.
Support the planning and execution of cross-channel acquisition and retention campaigns (in-app, push, SMS, paid social), coordinating with product, operations, and creative teams to ensure timely launches and consistent messaging.

Develop A/B test plans and track results for creative, channel mix, and incentive structures, documenting learnings and recommending scalable changes to reduce CPA and increase LTV.
Prepare concise business-facing reports and presentation decks that translate campaign findings into actionable recommendations for regional managers and senior stakeholders.
Monitor campaign budget spend and pacing, flagging risks and proposing reallocation strategies to maximize ROI while ensuring compliance with local market guidelines.
Assist in local market research and competitive benchmarking to adapt global campaign frameworks to regional behaviors and regulatory constraints, ensuring relevance and compliance.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Last years of bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred.
Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using Excel, SQL, or analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau) to manipulate datasets and derive actionable insights.
Proactive, collaborative attitude with experience working in cross-functional teams and the adaptability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership, able to manage campaign tracking, budget pacing, and documentation for multiple regional pilots concurrently.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

🌴 10 paid vacation days per year plus all U.S. federal holidays.

title: Growth & Customer Success Lead
skills: Gestión activa de cartera: contacto proactivo y sostenido con los comercios de alto valor (llamadas, visitas presenciales, revisión de métricas de procesamiento por merchant).

Subir penetración GPV/GMV: mover a cada comercio sobre el umbral (≥50%) y empujar hacia 60% / 70%; diagnosticar por qué cada uno no procesa más (fricción técnica, UX, preferencia por competidor, desconocimiento de features, soporte) y resolver o escalar.

Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools and systems that you need to succeed. You’ll drive the team forward, guiding them over every obstacle and leading the way to develop exciting, original and effective solutions. Leading the way, you’ll bring our team together to build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice.

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deliver software that benefits many customers around the world. Marketing Technology (MarTech) team's mission is to develop systems and tools that enable marketers to provide customers multi-touch, personalized and timely messages that enhance the experience of using our services. Customer journey automation and real-time targeting are examples of systems that the team works on. These systems are built using cutting edge technologies and products from AWS like Kinesis, S3, EMR, Elastic Search, etc.

About You

You’re in your element when you’re being challenged, and you’re always eager to share your ideas, take on responsibility and keep developing at an exciting pace. We look for people who show initiative, set their standards high and see every failure as an opportunity to learn. You’re looking for an environment where you can thrive and help your team reach their potential. With opportunities to challenge yourself and lead a talented team to success, you’ll find what you’re looking for at Audible.

 Lead complex technical initiatives within your team
 Mentor and support other developers by cultivating curiosity and deep technical understanding
 Explore technical needs and bring solutions to the table

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

A day in the life

 5+ years experience of software development and deployment of distributed multi-tier applications

title: Coordinador(a) de Operaciones y Experiencia del Cliente
description:
About the job

Sobre Xcape




Xcape Tours es un operador turístico premium en rápido crecimiento en la República Dominicana, especializado en ofrecer experiencias inolvidables en excursiones compartidas, grupos pequeños y tours privados. Atendemos a viajeros de todo el mundo a través de nuestro sitio web y de las principales plataformas de viajes, incluyendo Viator, GetYourGuide, Airbnb Experiences y otras.




A medida que continuamos creciendo, buscamos una persona organizada, proactiva y orientada al servicio al cliente que nos ayude a coordinar nuestras operaciones diarias y a brindar una experiencia excepcional a cada uno de nuestros huéspedes.




Esta es una posición con modalidad remote-first, que ofrece excelentes oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento profesional. 




Sobre el Puesto 




El Coordinador(a) de Operaciones y Experiencia del Cliente será responsable de garantizar la correcta ejecución de nuestras excursiones diarias mediante la coordinación de reservas, transporte, comunicación con los clientes y la logística operativa.




Trabajando directamente con el Fundador de la empresa, serás el principal punto de contacto entre los huéspedes, choferes, guías, suplidores y los diferentes equipos internos para asegurar que cada experiencia se desarrolle de manera eficiente desde el momento de la reserva hasta la finalización del servicio.




Esta posición es ideal para una persona que disfrute resolver problemas, trabajar en un entorno dinámico y ofrecer un servicio al cliente de primer nivel. 




Responsabilidades Principales 




Reservas y Servicio al Cliente 




● Responder de manera oportuna a las consultas de los clientes a través de WhatsApp, correo electrónico, teléfono, chat del sitio web, Airbnb y mensajería de las diferentes OTAs.

● Gestionar nuevas reservas, modificaciones, cancelaciones y solicitudes especiales.

● Enviar confirmaciones de reserva, instrucciones de recogida, recordatorios e información sobre las excursiones.

● Coordinar números de habitación, lugares de recogida, restricciones alimenticias y necesidades especiales de los clientes.

● Resolver inquietudes y situaciones de los clientes de manera profesional antes, durante y después de cada tour.

● Dar seguimiento a los huéspedes una vez finalizada su experiencia y motivarlos a dejar reseñas en línea. ● Mantener altos estándares de tiempo de respuesta y satisfacción del cliente. 




Operaciones y Logística de Tours 




● Coordinar la programación diaria de excursiones y la logística operativa.

● Confirmar diariamente las reservas y los manifiestos de pasajeros.

● Programar y confirmar guías, choferes, proveedores de transporte y suplidores.

● Verificar horarios de recogida, requisitos de acceso a hoteles y puntos de encuentro.

● Monitorear las recogidas activas y las salidas de las excursiones.

● Coordinar cambios operativos de última hora y resolver incidencias con rapidez.

● Comunicar actualizaciones operativas a huéspedes y suplidores.

● Asegurar que todas las excursiones se ejecuten conforme a los estándares y procedimientos establecidos por la empresa.

● Apoyar las iniciativas de control de calidad y mejora continua de las operaciones. 




Gestión de Reservas y OTAs 




● Administrar las reservas provenientes de Viator, GetYourGuide, Airbnb Experiences y otras plataformas de reservas.

● Actualizar disponibilidad, horarios e información de las reservas.

● Supervisar la exactitud de las reservas y detectar posibles inconsistencias.

● Responder los mensajes de clientes enviados a través de las OTAs.

● Ayudar a mantener actualizada la información operativa y el contenido de las diferentes plataformas




Operaciones de Airbnb 




● Coordinar la comunicación con los huéspedes antes y durante cada estadía.

● Programar servicios de limpieza y mantenimiento.

● Asegurar que las propiedades estén listas para recibir a los huéspedes.

● Apoyar los procesos de check-in, check-out y la resolución de incidencias.

● Monitorear las reseñas de los huéspedes y colaborar con la gestión de la reputación de las propiedades. 




Apoyo Administrativo 




● Mantener registros precisos de las reservas.

● Actualizar hojas de cálculo, reportes e información operativa.

● Dar seguimiento a cancelaciones, reembolsos e incidencias operativas.

● Preparar resúmenes operativos diarios.

● Apoyar la documentación de procesos y las iniciativas de mejora continua.

● Utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial y soluciones digitales para mejorar la eficiencia operativa. 




Perfil del Candidato




Buscamos una persona que cuente con:




● Excelente dominio del inglés y del español, tanto oral como escrito.

● Sólidas habilidades de servicio al cliente.

● Excelentes capacidades de organización y planificación.

● Capacidad para gestionar múltiples tareas y establecer prioridades.

● Alto nivel de atención al detalle.

● Buen manejo de herramientas informáticas, incluyendo Google Workspace y Microsoft Office.

● Actitud positiva, iniciativa y disposición para aprender continuamente.

● Se valorará experiencia previa en turismo, hotelería o servicio al cliente, aunque no es un requisito indispensable. 




¿Por Qué Unirte a Xcape Tours? 




● Trabajar directamente con el Fundador de la empresa.

● Formar parte de una empresa turística en rápido crecimiento.

● Disfrutar de una posición completamente remota.

● Adquirir experiencia en operaciones turísticas, servicio al cliente, gestión de reservas y administración de negocios.

● Aprender a utilizar herramientas tecnológicas líderes en la industria e Inteligencia Artificial.

● Construir una carrera profesional a largo plazo con oportunidades reales de crecimiento a medida que la empresa continúa expandiéndose. 




Información Adicional 




Esta es una posición con modalidad remote-first. Los candidatos deberán contar con una conexión estable a internet, un espacio de trabajo profesional en casa y la capacidad para desempeñarse de manera independiente. Como empresa en crecimiento, las responsabilidades de este puesto podrán evolucionar con el tiempo. Además de las funciones descritas anteriormente, la persona seleccionada podrá asumir otras tareas, proyectos especiales o responsabilidades relacionadas que le sean asignadas, de acuerdo con la naturaleza del puesto y las necesidades operativas de la empresa. Creemos firmemente en desarrollar el talento interno y promover a nuestros colaboradores siempre que sea posible. Esta posición ofrece una trayectoria clara de crecimiento profesional hacia roles de supervisión y gerencia a medida que Xcape Tours continúa expandiéndose.

Serás responsable de identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y liderar la expansión comercial de Bioelements en México, desarrollando relaciones de largo plazo con empresas líderes de retail, consumo masivo, e-commerce, entre otros.




Buscamos a alguien capaz de desarrollar mercados y convertirse en un socio estratégico para nuestros clientes.




Tus principales responsabilidades
Desarrollar nuevas oportunidades comerciales con empresas líderes del mercado mexicano.
Identificar industrias y categorías con alto potencial para expandir el portafolio de Bioelements.
Liderar procesos de venta consultiva con ciclos comerciales de mediano y largo plazo.
Gestionar un pipeline robusto de oportunidades y construir un forecast comercial confiable.
Desarrollar estrategias de entrada para nuevos mercados y nuevas aplicaciones de nuestros productos.
Participar en ferias, asociaciones, cámaras empresariales y eventos de la industria para fortalecer el posicionamiento de Bioelements.
Trabajar de manera transversal con Operaciones, Supply Chain, Finanzas y Marketing para asegurar implementaciones exitosas.




¿Qué buscamos?
Título universitario en Administración, Ingeniería, Negocios, Comercio o carrera afín.
Experiencia en Business Development, Market Development, Ventas B2B o Desarrollo Comercial.
Experiencia comprobable desarrollando nuevos negocios con grandes empresas.
Historial construyendo relaciones comerciales de largo plazo.
Experiencia en ventas consultivas y negociaciones complejas.
Capacidad para gestionar múltiples stakeholders y ciclos comerciales largos.
Inglés intermedio o avanzado.
Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de México.





¿Qué encontrarás en Bioelements?

Somos una empresa en crecimiento, con presencia internacional y una misión clara: acelerar la transición hacia soluciones de packaging más sostenibles.

Aquí tendrás la oportunidad de construir mercado, desarrollar nuevas categorías y trabajar con algunas de las compañías más importantes de Latinoamérica, generando un impacto real en la industria.

Si disfrutas abrir puertas, construir relaciones de confianza y desarrollar negocios que generen impacto a largo plazo, queremos conocerte.

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As Vendor Manager, you'll work with different vendors to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for looking after a brand’s product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed monthly reports on performance. You’ll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive category growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 2+ years of market research analyst, product manager, or equivalent experience
 2+ years of doing one of several roles: quantitative/financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, pricing, marketing or e-commerce experience
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 +2 YOE driving internal cross-team collaboration
 Bachelor's Degree.


Preferred Qualifications


 3+ years of doing one of several roles: management consulting, investment banking analyst/associate, or brand manager role at leading consumer packaged goods company experience
 Experience in financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, marketing, business development, consulting, negotiation or supply chain

description:
About the job

Analista – Análisis Económico 

HR Ratings | Santa Fe, Ciudad de México | Tiempo Completo




Sobre HR Ratings

HR Ratings es una agencia calificadora con operaciones en México, Latinoamérica y Estados Unidos que emite más de 2,500 calificaciones al año. Nuestra operación se caracteriza por mantener altos estándares de calidad, profundidad financiera y cumplimiento regulatorio, trabajando bajo una cultura de excelencia, ética profesional y mejora continua. Estamos registrados ante la CNBV (México) y ante la SEC (EUA) y aprobados por el NAIC como proveedor de calificaciones crediticias (CRA) y certificados por ESMA (Europa) y por FCA (Reino Unido), lo que nos permite operar conforme a los marcos regulatorios respectivos de cada región.




Nuestra presencia global se fortalece año con año lo que nos convierte en una de las calificadoras más reconocidas globalmente.




Formar parte de HR Ratings significa integrarte a un ambiente profundamente colaborativo y retador intelectualmente, donde el aprendizaje constante y el desarrollo profesional son pilares fundamentales.




Objetivo del Puesto

En HR Ratings buscamos talento analítico, estratégico y con enfoque financiero para integrarse a nuestro equipo de Análisis Económico. Esta posición representa una excelente oportunidad para desarrollar tu carrera dentro de una empresa internacional con enfoque global.




El analista de Economía será responsable de apoyar en el proceso analítico del área de economía, que incluye la realización de comentarios económicos, con un énfasis especial en México y los Estados Unidos. La posición participará activamente en el análisis macroeconómico, incluyendo las finanzas públicas, el entorno monetario y entidades estratégicas.




Principales Responsabilidades

Elaborar, administrar y actualizar bases de datos
Creación de escenarios macroeconómicos y eventualmente, en el apoyo de desarrollo de calificaciones soberanas.
Analizar el entorno macroeconómico y su impacto.
Análisis de política fiscal y política monetaria.
Monitoreo de eventos macroeconómicos, financieros, sectoriales políticos y regulatorios que puedan afectar las calificaciones asignadas.

description:
About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly




Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand—we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.

As we expand into the U.S., we're investing in a new capability: an AI-powered Consumer Intelligence Hub that continuously transforms consumer signals into better business decisions.

Rather than relying on traditional research, we're building a proprietary intelligence system that combines first-party data, social conversations, creator communities, AI and strategic thinking to guide Product, Brand, Growth and Retail.

We're looking for someone to lead that capability.




The Opportunity




This is not a traditional Consumer & Market Insights role.

You won't spend your time commissioning surveys and writing research reports.

Instead, you'll build and own Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence function, working at the intersection of consumer understanding, AI and business strategy.

Your mission is simple: Turn consumer signals into better business decisions.

Working alongside an external AI Intelligence Architect and the executive team, you'll help build one of the first AI-native Consumer Intelligence capabilities in beauty.




Key Responsibilities




Build Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Framework




Define and continuously refine Sarelly's proprietary consumer taxonomy.
Organize consumer signals around business questions rather than platforms.
Ensure our AI systems are trained to identify meaningful consumer patterns instead of simply reporting data.
Continuously improve the quality and relevance of our intelligence model.




Define the AI Intelligence Architect




You'll lead the building of the technical infrastructure: 

Define how raw consumer data should be categorized and tagged.
Brief AI workflows and prompting frameworks.
Validate AI outputs
Identify new data sources that should be integrated into the system.




Translate Intelligence into Business Recommendations




You'll synthesize consumer intelligence into executive recommendations.

Your recommendations will directly influence:

Product Innovation
Franchise Development
Marketing
Creator Strategy
CRM
Retail




What Success Looks Like




Identify emerging consumer needs before competitors.
Translate consumer language into stronger messaging.
Identify product innovation opportunities earlier.
Improve creator selection and content strategy.
Make faster, evidence-based business decisions.




Become the Internal Expert on Latina Consumers




Help Sarelly develop the deepest understanding of Latina beauty consumers in the industry.

This includes understanding differences across:

Cultural identities
Heritage groups
Beauty routines
Consumer language
Shopping behaviors
Generations
Geographic markets
Emerging cultural trends

Rather than treating the Latina consumer as one audience, you'll help us understand the nuances that drive relevance.




Build a Learning Organization




Champion a culture of curiosity across the company. Help teams move from reporting observations to generating insights and making better business decisions.




Required Experience




2-3 

years in Consumer Insights, Innovation.
Experience working with multicultural or diverse consumer audiences.
Strong qualitative and strategic thinking skills.
Experience translating consumer research into business recommendations.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
Fluent in English and Spanish.




Preferred Experience




Strong preference for candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

Beauty or personal care
Consumer packaged goods
Creator economy
Community-led brands
Consumer innovation
Consumer segmentation
U.S. Hispanic / Latina consumers
Mexican and U.S. markets

Experience across different Latina sub-communities and target demographics is highly valued.




AI Requirements (Must Have)




We are intentionally building an AI-native Consumer Intelligence function.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be highly AI-literate.

You should be comfortable:

Working daily with Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI tools.
Developing prompts and AI workflows.
Validating AI-generated insights.
Using AI to accelerate research and synthesis.
Rethinking traditional research methods through AI rather than simply replicating existing processes.

Curiosity about AI and willingness to experiment are essential.




Skills




Consumer research
Strategic thinking
Hypothesis generation
Pattern recognition
Cultural analysis
Storytelling
AI literacy
Project management
Cross-functional collaboration




Mindset




We're looking for someone who:

Is endlessly curious about people.
Naturally connects dots that others miss.
Questions assumptions before accepting them.
Loves experimenting with AI.
Enjoys building systems, not just reports.
Thinks like a strategist, not only a researcher.
Wants to help build a capability that doesn't yet exist.




Why Join Sarelly?




This is a rare opportunity to build the Consumer Intelligence function from the ground up.

Rather than inheriting traditional research processes, you'll help define how AI and human judgment work together to create a structural competitive advantage for one of the most culturally relevant beauty brands in the market.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


About The Role
We're looking for a hands-on, customer-empathetic Credit Supervisor to own credit management, credit limit increases (CLI), and collections for our Mexico Credit Card. This is a founding role: you will build these frameworks and processes from the ground up.

The Lenda credit card is a mobile app–first product targeted at the credit builder segment in Mexico. We empower customers to access the formal financial ecosystem and build their credit profile over time, while offering a flexible and responsible line of credit tailored to their needs.

What makes this role different from a traditional credit management role is that you think about the customer experience as a credit lever. In a mobile-first, credit builder product, how customers experience the card — activation flows, payment reminders, limit increase offers — directly drives delinquency and engagement. You will work closely with Product and Operations to ensure the customer journey and credit performance reinforce each other.

We are looking for builders and doers that get things done.
In practice, this means being equally comfortable:


Defining and managing CLI eligibility, timing, and quality assurance
Designing collections strategies that balance recovery with customer empathy
Diving into portfolio metrics, roll rates, and delinquency trends
Collaborating with Product on customer-facing flows that influence credit behavior
Coordinating with Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Customer Support
Driving operational excellence and automation within credit management processes
Having a deep understanding of how post-acquisition performance impacts our P&L


What You'll Be Responsible For
This role will cover all aspects of credit management and collections for our Mexico Credit Card, including:


Owning portfolio performance post-acquisition: delinquency rates, roll rates, loss curves, profitability
Designing and continuously improving the CLI framework — eligibility, timing, sizing, and quality assurance
Building and leading the collections strategy: early-stage treatments, communication flows, escalation paths, recovery rates
Monitoring management KPIs: DPD buckets, NPL rates, recovery rates, CLI uptake and performance
Identifying behavioral signals that predict delinquency and building proactive intervention strategies
Collaborating with Product on customer-facing flows (payment reminders, activation nudges, CLI offers) that influence credit behavior
Supporting customers experiencing financial difficulty with responsible, empathy-driven solutions
Working with Data Science to build and refine behavioral scoring and collections models
Ensuring compliance with Mexican financial regulations for collections and customer treatment
Improving operational efficiency through automation and tooling


You will have the freedom and responsibility to shape how credit is managed in Mexico from the ground up.

How You'll Work
Credit leaders at Lendable work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Growth to ensure strong portfolio health and sustainable expansion.

It's your job to:


Connect customer behavior patterns to portfolio risk outcomes
Prioritize interventions based on impact on delinquency and profitability
Balance commercial objectives with fair, empathy-driven customer outcomes
Experiment with new collections treatments, measure, and iterate quickly


We encourage all our teams to think big, act fast, and continuously improve.

Experience
You have a solid background in credit management, collections, or consumer lending. You're hands-on, customer-centric, and comfortable moving between strategy, execution, and analysis. Ideally, you bring:


Proficiency in English and Spanish
Solid understanding of credit management fundamentals: delinquency curves, roll rates, vintage analysis, recovery rates, P&L impact of collections
Experience in credit card or consumer lending portfolio management
Experience designing or managing collections strategies (early, mid, and late stage)
Comfort with SQL — you can independently query portfolio data to monitor performance and investigate anomalies
Experience leveraging AI tools to run analyses and drive faster decisions
Strong customer empathy — you understand that collections is a customer experience problem, not just a financial one
Good at communicating to different stakeholders
Strong ownership mentality and accountability for portfolio performance
Agency: you move fast, iterate based on feedback, and proactively flag issues before they escalate
Bonus: Experience thinking about UX or customer journey in the context of credit outcomes (activation, payment behavior, engagement)
Bonus: Experience in credit builder, thin-file, or underbanked segments
Bonus: Some experience on Fraud (especially first-party fraud in collections contexts)
Bonus: Experience in start-up/scale-up environments, credit cards, or fintech
Bonus: Familiarity with Mexican financial regulations for collections (CONDUSEF, CNBV)


The type of work you'll be doing

Own and drive credit management performance, strategy, and execution
Define and monitor KPIs related to delinquency, collections, CLI performance, and profitability
Lead CLI quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives
Design and iterate on collections communication flows and treatment strategies
Collaborate with Data Science to refine behavioral scoring and collections models
Develop internal credit monitoring dashboards and reporting frameworks
Liaise with Product to improve customer-facing flows that influence payment behavior and engagement
Liaise with Operations and Customer Support to ensure smooth credit and collections workflows
Build internal tools to automate manual work and make processes more efficient
Contribute to credit committee discussions and risk governance
Champion data-driven decision-making, measuring outcomes, and iterating quickly based on learnings
Navigate a fast-paced, evolving fintech landscape, balancing innovation with compliance and risk management


How you will contribute to the Credit Team's objectives


Autonomy: You're comfortable owning and managing the entire credit management line with minimal oversight.
Agency: You proactively find things to implement and improve.
Prioritisation: You independently prioritise and ruthlessly focus on what drives the most impact.
Accountability: You ensure portfolio health and collections performance remain strong as we scale.
Decision-Making: You balance growth and prudence in a fast-paced environment.
Collaboration: You work closely with stakeholders across product, data science, operations, and customer service, quickly assembling cross-functional teams to deliver.
Problem Solving: You break down complex business problems into manageable parts and consistently find practical solutions.
Analysis: You're highly comfortable with numbers, using SQL and analytics tools to turn data into real-world actions.
Communication: You communicate clearly and adapt your style to suit any audience, from engineers to executives — and you're humble enough to change your mind when presented with a better idea.
Creative Mindset: You are open to doing things in a new, better way.
Agility: You thrive in an evolving fintech environment with high ownership and responsibility. You adapt quickly in an unstructured, fast-moving, and constantly evolving environment.


Location

In office in Mexico City
Under very special cases this could be remote. Although frequent presence in the Mexico City office would be required.


Life at Lendable

Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members
Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Amazon MGM Studios seeks a Trade Marketing & Sales Support Manager for Theatrical Distribution across Mexico who will be responsible for developing and executing co-operative trade marketing campaigns with cinema circuits while providing essential sales support to maximize commercial performance across the theatrical slate.

This dual-function role combines strategic marketing promotional partnerships and in-theatre marketing implementations with operational sales execution, working closely with exhibitors in Mexico to optimize both promotional impact and booking performance. The position translates release strategies into circuit-specific marketing activations while supporting session planning, booking management, and box office analysis. Trade Marketing & Exhibitor Collaborations

 Coordinate joint and integrated local promotional activities including in-cinema displays, website and lobby takeovers, premium format promotions, and digital signage campaigns, point of sale & concession campaigns
 Lead creative localization and/or development for in-theater materials/assets based on each film's global campaign and local strategy

 Analyze correlation between marketing spend by circuit and box office and market share performance to optimize future campaigns

 Proven experience with co-operative marketing agreements and managing collaboration budgets
 Confidence working with spreadsheets, databases, sales tools and business intelligence platforms
 Excellent communication and presentation abilities with internal teams and external partners

Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok e-Commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-Commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. description:
About the job

En GlobalSuite Solutions somos una empresa tecnológica internacional especializada en Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC).

Nuestra plataforma GlobalSuite® ayuda a organizaciones de todo el mundo a gestionar sus riesgos, continuidad de negocio, cumplimiento normativo, auditorías y ciberseguridad desde un entorno unificado.

Con más de 2.000 clientes internacionales y presencia en Europa y Latinoamérica, seguimos ampliando nuestro equipo en México, desde donde impulsamos nuestra expansión en toda la región LATAM.




Buscamos un/a Sales Development Representative (SDR) especializado/a en prospección outbound, cuya misión será identificar, contactar y cualificar nuevas oportunidades comerciales en el mercado B2B.

Tu rol será clave para abrir puertas, conectar con empresas objetivo e impulsar el crecimiento de GlobalSuite Solutions mediante estrategias multicanal altamente efectivas.

Formarás parte del área de ventas y colaborarás estrechamente con los equipos de marketing y desarrollo de negocio para generar un pipeline sólido, real y de calidad.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Incorporación a un equipo comercial en plena expansión.
Formación continua en producto, procesos de venta y marcos normativos GRC.
Oportunidades de crecimiento dentro del área comercial.
Remuneración competitiva + variable según rendimiento y pipeline generado.
Entorno colaborativo, dinámico y orientado a la innovación.
Vacaciones de libre disposición.




¿Qué requisitos y habilidades buscamos?

Experiencia mínima de 1-2 años como SDR, BDR o en prospección outbound B2B (idealmente en entornos SaaS, tech o software empresarial).
Manejo experto de herramientas de automatización y prospección: Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay u otras equivalentes.
Comprensión sólida del proceso de venta B2B y de dinámicas comerciales basadas en outbound.
Alta capacidad de comunicación, organización y gestión del tiempo.
Orientación a resultados, métricas y calidad del pipeline generado. Se definirán KPIS muy claros para el proceso.
Español nativo y nivel intermedio/avanzado de inglés.




¿Qué más valoramos?

Experiencia previa en sectores como GRC, ciberseguridad, cumplimiento o gestión de riesgos.
Conocimientos de CRM (Microsoft Dynamics u otros).
Capacidad analítica para interpretar métricas y optimizar secuencias de prospección.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos internacionales o distribuidos.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Desarrollar estrategias de outbound prospecting en la zona de LATAM orientadas a cuentas objetivo definidas.
Investigar y segmentar empresas utilizando herramientas como LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, Clay u otras plataformas similares.
Ejecutar secuencias de contacto multicanal (email, LinkedIn, llamadas) diseñadas para maximizar la conversión.
Cualificar oportunidades en base a criterios definidos por el equipo de ventas.
Mantener actualizado el CRM con todas las interacciones y actividad comercial.
Identificar patrones, insights y aprendizajes sobre el mercado para mejorar la estrategia de prospección.
Colaborar activamente con marketing en la alineación de mensajes, pitch y audiencias objetivo.
Reportar métricas clave de desempeño: contactos realizados, tasas de conversión, oportunidades generadas, etc.
